claim: The last link of the knowledge graph is now enforced: every EVD-* cited by a knowledge record must exist as an artifact in docs/evidence. Auditing that same rule across the whole repository found a pre-existing hole that this change deliberately does not paper over: EVD-0036 is cited by specs, ADRs, intake documents and a security matrix, and no such evidence artifact exists.
scope: Evidence-reference validation inside docs/intelligence (fail closed, zero debt), plus a measured out-of-scope finding recorded rather than fixed. No evidence artifact was created: fabricating evidence is the one thing this system must never do.
source: EVD-0080 follow-up; repo-wide scan of 1855 documents
action: Added section 8 to the lock: collect existing EVD ids from docs/evidence, scan every knowledge record for cited EVD tokens, fail closed on missing ones, and emit a positive check when clean. Added two unit tests.
expected: 'Checks Passed: 868 | Failures: 0', exit 0, 2 warnings, 28/28 tests (previous state 866 with no evidence rule; delta +2 = the new positive check and this record).
actual: 'Checks Passed: 868 | Failures: 0', exit 0, 2 warnings, tests 28 pass 0 fail. The live audit reports 3 checks including 'evidence references vs docs/evidence (67 artifacts)'.
risks: The rule only guards the knowledge graph. Outside docs/intelligence there are still unguarded evidence citations, and the one found is a real defect that a human must resolve.
Creating EVD-0036 to make the gap disappear would manufacture an audit trail for work that has no recorded execution. That option is rejected explicitly.
limitations: Repo-wide scan measured 425 EVD mentions, 403 resolvable, 3 unresolvable ids: EVD-0036 (real dangling reference), EVD-1787 and EVD-9999 (range and placeholder notation in KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_MODEL.md and the rationalization JSONs, not references). Gating the whole repository would need that distinction encoded, which is why the check is scoped to knowledge records for now.

EVD-0036's citations live in docs/specs, docs/architecture/adrs, docs/intake and docs/evidence/EOS_STEP_9_SECURITY_MATRIX.json; resolving them means either authoring the missing record from real execution or correcting eight documents, and both are human decisions.
review_findings: OUT-OF-SCOPE DEFECT (recorded, not fixed): EVD-0036 is cited as evidence in at least eight documents and no artifact exists. This is the strongest form of the anti-pattern ANT-0003 covers, committed by the repository itself.
SCOPE DECISION: EVD-1787 and EVD-9999 are notation (id ranges and placeholders), not references. Treating them as defects would produce false positives and train reviewers to ignore the gate.
